findings.description: The KMS key used to encrypt the logs bucket does not set enable_key_rotation, so it defaults to false and the key material is never automatically rotated. Long-lived key material increases the impact window if the key is ever compromised and violates common key-management baselines.

No explicit key policy is defined, so AWS applies the default policy granting the entire account root full access to the key, meaning any IAM principal in the account with kms permissions can decrypt log data. An explicit least-privilege key policy should scope usage to the log-writing and log-reading principals.
